test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years on a sum of Rs. 11000 at a rate of 11% per annum.
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ For **2 years**, the **difference** between **Compound Interest (CI)** and **Simple Interest (SI)** is the interest calculated on the first year's interest. Interest for 1st year = 11% of ₹11000 = ₹1210. Difference = 11% of ₹1210 = ₹133.1. **∴ The correct answer is ₹133.1.** **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹11000, **Rate (R)** = 11%, **Time (T)** = 2 years. **Formula:** **Difference (D)** = P × (R/100)² [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51a0a3cd1995eae6722355fb5bf8929e8f396588d5be9187436000b976098f2d.png] ⇒ Difference = 11000 × (11/100)² ⇒ Difference = 11000 × (121/10000) ⇒ Difference = 11 × 12.1 ⇒ Difference = 133.1 **∴ The correct answer is ₹133.1.** **__Additional Information__**
